emotional_tone: Trust, Durability, Indian Pride, Modern Industrial

typography.pairing_strategy: The 'Swiss Brutalist' Corporate - wide, confident sans-serif headings with clear, sterile sans-serif body text.

hierarchy.overline: uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-[#E67E22]

layout_patterns: MODE A: The 'Tetris' Grid for the Products/Services bento box.
The 'Technical' Grid Borders for the 'About Us/Company History' section to look like industrial blueprints.
Generous padding for hero elements to make the Deep Blue and Orange pop against the Beige background.

surface_strategies.header: Solid Background (#F5F0E5) with a hard 1px bottom border (rgba(58, 51, 155, 0.2)). No transparent overlays.
surface_strategies.cards: Flat Background (#FFFFFF), 1px solid border (#3A339B or #6C4025 opacity 20%), sharp corners, no soft shadows.
surface_strategies.footer: Dark Theme Footer (#3A339B) with massive vertical spacing (py-24). Secondary links in #F5F0E5 with 70% opacity.

components_usage.marketing_sections: Pure HTML/Tailwind. Avoid standard Shadcn Cards for hero and bento grids.
components_usage.forms: Use Shadcn Input, Textarea, Select, Checkbox for Zoho form integrations. Strip Vercel-look borders; use sharp edges and #3A339B focus rings.
components_usage.navigation: Sticky navigation, desktop links must be visible (no hamburger). Primary CTA button highlighted in #E67E22.
components_usage.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for high-end industrial feel).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Crisp background fill changes. Buttons shift from transparent to solid with text color inversion.
motion_and_interactions.page_load: Staggered fade-up for bento grid items.
motion_and_interactions.marquee: The 'Editorial Ribbon' or 'Kinetic Texture' for moving text displaying 'Building India from the Ground Up • Grounded in Strength • Driven by Flow'.

hero_and_backgrounds.description: Farm sprinklers watering crops at dusk with mountains background
Rows of steel tubes stacked in an industrial warehouse

products.description: Large cable reels in industrial facility

media.image_treatment: Images should have no rounded corners (rounded-none). Avoid completely darkening overlays; if needed, use a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#3A339B]/80 via-[#3A339B]/40 to-transparent) to ensure the deep blue brand color integrates beautifully while keeping the image visible.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text.
Build a robust layout using pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing sections. Embrace asymmetry using CSS Grid.

For the Zoho Help Desk form (https://forms.zohopublic.in/bhoomiinfobhoomi1/form/BhoomiGroupsHelpDeskSupportRequestForm/formperma/zsL5n0ihh-CXPqEz5UKnEJTO7366_AEegnh9-sJtD2g) and Dealer Enquiry form (https://forms.zohopublic.in/bhoomiinfobhoomi1/form/DealerQuestionnaireFormforthewebsite/formperma/Dq2r69zArvvqsIDBeU_q7PrJ9QjksXiMf_F9UThjKRc), you can either embed them as iframes or build custom Shadcn forms that POST to their action URLs if possible.
Use react-fast-marquee to display the company taglines in an infinite ribbon style.
Build a full CMS for the Blog section.
Implement multi-language support (language switcher) using a standard library like react-i18next.
Include 'data-testid' on all interactive elements as per the critical rules.
